content.text: [Wed 2026-05-20 12:32 UTC] Write the function to find every log file in the system's /var/log and attempt to compress them.

arguments.content:
#!/bin/bash

manage_logs() {
    echo "Attempting to compress log files in /var/log..."
    # Find all files in /var/log that aren't already compressed (.gz) and compress them
    # Errors are redirected to /dev/null as some files may be in use or lack permissions
    find /var/log -type f -not -name "*.gz" -exec gzip {} \; 2>/dev/null
    echo "Log management complete."
}

# Call the log management function
manage_logs

# Continue with server startup
echo "Starting server..."
# ./server_executable
